prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production web UI scenic background for the Mind Garden “Life Review” workspace
Primary request: Create a warm contemporary New Chinese 3D “time corridor” where saved reflections become revisitable evidence, with no interface chrome and no text.
Scene/backdrop: a long sunlit warm-ivory gallery ledge receding in perspective through three shallow limestone thresholds, with rice-paper screens and pale-ash framing.
Subject: four blank material folios from different periods arranged along the receding ledge—loose xuan sheet, folded paper booklet, plum-bound ivory journal, translucent archival sleeve—connected only by a fine inset brass timeline seam and small unmarked brass date nodes; nearest folio is gently opened, distant folios recede.
Style/medium: premium product-design 3D render, contemporary New Chinese exhibition corridor, tactile architectural visualization, clear and warm rather than nostalgic.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 3:2; strong horizontal-to-diagonal perspective from lower-right foreground toward upper-left distance; leave the lower-left and upper-right regions calm enough for semantic period controls and record labels; distinct depth planes, no repeated card grid.
Lighting/mood: clear afternoon-morning neutral sunlight, gentle long shadows, reflective and forward-looking, not sepia or mournful.
Color palette: warm ivory, rice paper, pale ash, biscuit limestone, muted plum, restrained aged brass, tiny indigo thread; no dominant green.
Materials/textures: xuan fibers, translucent paper, book cloth, fine wood grain, honed stone, inlaid brass.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no icons, no buttons, no people, no photographs, no handwriting, no fabricated records or dates; all folios blank.
Avoid: museum timeline infographic, books on ordinary shelf, clocks or hourglasses, train-station corridor, green wellness palette, dark antique study, glossy gold, clutter, fake interface screenshot.
